description: This file defines the interface IGatewayListProvider in the Orleans.Messaging namespace, which provides methods and properties for managing and retrieving the list of gateway endpoints for an Orleans cluster.

classes.name: IGatewayListProvider
classes.description: An interface that provides Orleans gateways information, including initialization, retrieval of gateway list, staleness period, and updatability status.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, called before other methods.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns a list of available gateway endpoints as Uri objects.
